assets.alt_text: Sacbrood-affected Apis cerana larva held with tweezers, showing the characteristic sac-like body
assets.caption: Real clinical sacbrood reference in Apis cerana. Comparable brood signs must be interpreted with colony pattern and other findings; the image alone is not definitive diagnosis.
assets.credit: Photo by Xiaoqing Li; source: Wei et al., Viruses 14 (2022), Figure 1, CC BY 4.0.
